text:
Alex K: quick standup — what I did / blockers / today

Did: drained 3 prewarm nodes in us-west1 for the canary, monitored p50 and saw ~0.6s increase during drain but overall throughput stable.
Blockers: APAC quota still low for asia-southeast1 (we only have 4 spot GPUs free) — need a reserve for next-week spike.
Today: opening quota request, pinging CR for scheduler, updating runbook and canary config. cc @Priya S @Dan L

Priya S: eyeballing regional headroom now — us-west1 looks ok (≈20% spare), us-east1 = tight (~92% committed). asia-southeast1 only 4 GPUs and they're spot. we should request reserved capacity if we expect sustained traffic. I'll take the quota ticket.

Dan L: canary suggestion: shift to us-west2 if we can't get APAC reserved in time (lower blast radius). Also pinging for CR #3425 — needs one more review before merge, @Emily R can you take a look?

Emily R: on it, give me until 10:30 PT. quick Q — during the drain did you see any cold-starts in the dedupe service? logs show a couple of `KV cache` misses around the same time.

Alex K: yes saw 2 cold starts, both during the TTL eviction window. gonna bump cache ttl in canary config to reduce noise. patch snippet: ```yaml
# config/canary/prewarm.yaml
name: canary_prewarm
cache_ttl: 21600 # seconds (6h)
replicas: 3
```

InfraBot: Automated: quota request created Q-9812 for asia-southeast1 (4x A100). ETA vendor: 48-72h. Link: https://internal/requests/Q-9812

Priya S: thanks infra-bot. i'll escalate to cloud-accounts for a rapid RR tomorrow morning. also adding note: scheduler should have fallback routing to prefer us-west2 if APAC quota is pending.

Dan L: SGTM. CR notes: left one nit on variable naming but nothing blocking. @Emily R after you merge, canary rollout schedule proposal: 15:00 UTC, 10-min ramp, health-check windows. need rollback plan too.

Emily R: 15:00 UTC works for me. rollback plan: revert to model-v2, scale replicas down to 0, re-route traffic back within 5m. i'll write this up in the rollout doc and add checks.

Alex K: :thumbsup: i'll update the runbook with the thresholds (p50/p95, error-rate) and add the `cache_ttl` change in the canary commit. blocker still APAC quota — @Priya S please ping me if cloud-accounts respond earlier so we can decide to keep canary in APAC or shift.

Priya S: will do. end of standup: Did — drained + observed; Blockers — APAC quota Q-9812; Today — CR ping, runbook update, schedule rollout.
